title: Vision Zero Monitor: EU road safety statistics, legislation and commitments
description:
An open, static website and data pipelines that bring together official EU road safety statistics (Eurostat, CARE), EU road safety legislation (EUR-Lex metadata) and EU and global road safety commitments, with full provenance for every value. Missing values are published as null, never estimated.

Each release archives the code and the versioned data files in public/data/. The statistics remain © European Union (Eurostat), reused under Commission Decision 2011/833/EU; cite the official source of a figure first. Live site: dalust.github.io/Vision-Zero-Monitor.
